GameplayDescription: ['The Overseer dives from the air and charges forward. Can be blocked with a parry. Upon a successful parry, the Overseer becomes paralyzed.', 'When hit, the Overseer blocks the attack, knocks the target back, and counterattacks. After blocking a certain number of times, the Overseer becomes paralyzed.', 'The Overseer fires three consecutive bombardments at the target in the center of the battlefield from the judgment platform. Try to perform a blade counter during the brief window each time. Successfully counter the third attack, and the Overseer will be paralyzed.']

StageDescriptions: ['Hand of the Raging Tide', 'Meteoric Requiem', 'Tidal Slash', 'Abyssal Devourer', 'Meteor Slash']
GameplayDescription: ['"Chiko" tears through the void, summoning tentacles from within to attack the targets.', '"Chiko" charges before expanding a field, summoning meteors that fall randomly within the area.', '"Chiko" slashes the target three times in a row with dual blades. These slashes can be parried. Three successful parries will paralyze "Chiko" temporarily.', '"Chiko" submerges and hunts like a shark, attacking the target meanwhile. The attack can be parried.', '"Chiko" jumps backward and combines her dual blades into a giant claw, then charges forward to slash the target and follows up with a downward smash. The attack can be parried.']
